relationships.subject: Nav1.9
relationships.evidence_quote: Nav1.9 KO mice shows less stimulation-induced calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) release form skin

key_findings: Nav1.9 knockout mice show progressive high-frequency hearing loss with reduced ribbon synapses and basal-turn SGNs
Nav1.9 is expressed in afferent endings beneath inner hair cells and in SGN somata
